source: GitHub REST API and each repository README

repositories.description: Agent Skills for working with React Router
repositories.title: React Router Agent Skills
repositories.summary: Routing instructions for agents working with React Router. The original collection covered framework, data, and declarative modes.
repositories.useCase: Use the current official skill when you need help with routes, loaders, forms, or pending states.
repositories.prompt: Review my route structure and loading states. Follow the official React Router skill and the version installed in this project.

repositories.description: Agent Skills for optimizing web quality based on Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals.
repositories.title: Web Quality Skills
repositories.summary: A measurement-first collection for Lighthouse checks, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and SEO. It works across frameworks.
repositories.useCase: Start here when a page looks finished but still feels slow or is hard to use with a keyboard.
repositories.prompt: Audit this page for loading performance, layout shifts, keyboard access, and crawlability. Measure first, then fix the highest-impact issue.

repositories.description: Agent skills for designers and builders using Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI coding agents
repositories.title: MengTo Skills
repositories.summary: Design and build workflows that turn visual references, screen recordings, and existing pages into detailed implementation prompts.
repositories.useCase: Useful when you have a clear visual reference but your agent keeps missing the layout or interaction details.
repositories.prompt: Study my reference, describe its spacing and interaction patterns, then plan a small implementation that fits my existing site.

repositories.description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
repositories.title: ConardLi Garden Skills
repositories.summary: A collection covering web design, visual presentations, article layouts, image workflows, and knowledge retrieval.
repositories.useCase: A good place to explore when your frontend work includes tutorials, presentations, or content-heavy pages.
repositories.prompt: Turn this outline into a readable article layout. Keep the heading hierarchy clear and make the code and links easy to find.

repositories.description: Production-grade AI agent skills for React 19, Next.js 16, TypeScript 7, testing, data, UI, and frontend architecture—ready for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Pi, and more.
repositories.title: React Frontend Skills
repositories.summary: PyModel's collection covers React and Next.js, TypeScript, UI, testing, data handling, and feature-based frontend architecture.
repositories.useCase: Use it for a React feature that needs more than a component: data validation, loading states, tests, and a clear folder structure.
repositories.prompt: Plan this React feature around my installed package versions. Include data fetching, validation, error states, and tests.

repositories.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repositories.title: Addy Osmani Agent Skills
repositories.summary: Engineering workflows for defining a task, planning the work, building in small steps, testing, reviewing, and shipping.
repositories.useCase: Useful when an agent jumps into coding before it understands the problem or skips the checks at the end.
repositories.prompt: Write a short spec and a step-by-step plan for this feature. Build one working slice, test it, and review the diff before continuing.

repositories.title: Emil Kowalski Skills
repositories.summary: Design-engineering guidance focused on motion and small UI details, including animation reviews and choosing easing and duration.
repositories.useCase: Reach for it when a menu, dialog, button, or page transition feels awkward rather than helpful.
repositories.prompt: Review this dialog's animation. Explain the easing, duration, and properties you would change, and respect reduced-motion settings.

repositories.description: Vercel's official collection of agent skills
repositories.title: Vercel Agent Skills
repositories.summary: Vercel's collection includes React and Next.js performance practices, web interface guidelines, and other platform-focused skills.
repositories.useCase: Useful for reviewing data-fetching waterfalls, bundle size, re-renders, and the details that make an interface easier to use.
repositories.prompt: Review this React page for unnecessary re-renders and slow data fetching. Prioritize the biggest bottleneck and explain how to verify the fix.

repositories.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
repositories.title: Impeccable
repositories.summary: Design guidance and focused commands for auditing, critiquing, polishing, simplifying, and improving an existing interface.
repositories.useCase: Start here when a page works but its spacing, typography, copy, or visual hierarchy still feels generic.
repositories.prompt: Critique this page for hierarchy, spacing, and clarity. Keep my existing brand and navigation; suggest three focused improvements before editing.

repositories.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repositories.title: UI UX Pro Max
repositories.summary: A design-focused skill with guidance for styles, palettes, typography, UX, and building a design system around a project's needs.
repositories.useCase: Useful early in a project, when you need a consistent visual direction rather than a different style on every screen.
repositories.prompt: Propose a design system for this product and audience. Define typography, color, spacing, and component states before building the first page.
